{{Quote|Bomber squadron Quad Victor commencing bombing run.|A member of Quad Victor during the devastation of Da Soocha|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
Consisting of at least three [[Sith–Imperial attack ship]]s, '''Quad Victor''' was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[138 ABY]], Quad Victor, under orders from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azard]], was dispatched from the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[War Hammer]]'' to [[Devastation of Da Soocha|deploy]] canisters containing [[viral spore]]s into the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Da Soocha]]. The viral spores contaminated the world's oceans, [[Death/Legends|killing]] all life on Da Soocha.

==History==
{{Quote|Squadron Quad Victor. Mission accomplished. Returning to base.|A member of Quad Victor during the devastation of Da Soocha|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
Quad Victor was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Made up of at least three [[Sith–Imperial attack ship]]s, Quad Victor was stationed aboard the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[War Hammer]]''<ref name="Legacy 48" /> in early [[138 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Extremes Trade">Although the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]] indicates that its events take place in [[137 ABY]], the more recently released [[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 10: Extremes|''Star Wars: Legacy: Extremes'' trade paperback]] dates them at [[138 ABY]].</ref> the ''War Hammer'', under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azard]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rulf Yage]], was sent to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Da Soocha]], which had been harboring a number of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees wanted by Krayt's Empire. In retaliation, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Azard gave orders&mdash;relayed by Yage&mdash;for the Imperial forces to [[Devastation of Da Soocha|deploy]] [[viral spore]]s on Da Soocha, which would [[Death/Legends|kill]] all life on the planet. Escorted by a number of [[Sith-Imperial starfighter]]s, Quad Victor was dispatched from the ''War Hammer'' and proceeded to drop canisters of viral spores into Da Soocha's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. With their mission a success and the oceans of Da Soocha sufficiently contaminated, the bomber squadron returned to the ''War Hammer''.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quad Victor made its first and only appearance in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] was in [[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 26]], [[2010]].
